title: >>Profile sensitivity value<< is out of hard limits.
body:
Somewhere around 3PM on March 31, shortly after a brief patch pump connection issue, the error ">>Profile sensitivity value<< is out of hard limits." occured, followed by a very large number and "limited to 1000.00" APS results were reset to no avail. Around 9PM the App was rebuilt and updated by the user to version 3.3.2.0 and settings were rolled back to a month ago. A new patch was started and the issue seemed resolved until it reoccurred around 3AM.

Further information: 3 days prior to this issue, the user experienced a sequence of multiple unresolvable patch connection issues that appeared resolve itself after applying the latest patch before the issue in this post.
